newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrie says in talks with Br.Steel.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie says in talks with Br.Steel.

text.p: Indonesian holding company PT Bakrie & Brothers said on Wednesday the company was holding talks with possible joint venture partners, including British Steel, to build a steel plant in Lampung, South Sumatra.

"We are still in a preliminary stage. It is not finalised yet but it's true that British Steel is one of our potential partners," Wina Soemarko, Bakrie and Brothers assistant manager for investor relations, told Reuters.
She said investment in the project would range between $500 million to $1.0 billion but declined to give any indication when a final decision would be taken.
